canonical_parent_authority.head: 4d05863b0aa0217f7a18854d126697a2cb89e089
canonical_parent_authority.claim: Real multi-language adapter boundary remains sealed and unchanged.

laws.composition: Compatible AdapterContracts compose by semantic-space alignment and preserved-interface intersection.
laws.associativity: (C∘B)∘A = C∘(B∘A) at preservation meaning, automatic canonical contract identity, and protected-output level.
laws.identity: Canonical identity adapters are neutral on both sides and identity lowering preserves exact semantic-object bytes and ID.
laws.unknown: Interfaces not preserved by every leg fail closed to UNKNOWN(outside_preservation_contract).
laws.provenance: Composition provenance is the ordered canonical leaf-adapter path, not a parenthesization parse tree.

negative_lineage.head: 02e2e57c7c2faf1ec846cf902a99850e63878f3d
negative_lineage.finding: Preservation meaning was associative, but canonical AdapterContract identity was not because evidence_refs encoded intermediate composite IDs and therefore the parenthesization tree.
negative_lineage.correction: Flatten provenance to ordered leaf adapter-contract lineage and derive automatic composition identity from that canonical path.

claim_boundary: Bounded deterministic AdapterContract/reference-lowering semantics only. This establishes associativity and identity for the current open-interface composition algebra with canonical flattened provenance; it is not a universal category-theory theorem for arbitrary effectful or partial translators.
